description: Repairs r-txn-1b/xproc-held-cursors-membership: the 'as is' reads after A's commit came within about 10 ms, so the staleness of the held cursors may be cache timing rather than transaction visibility. On r-txn-1b-main-accdb, both processes open the main file shared read/write. b: opens dynaset hd and snapshot hs on SELECT ID, V, Z FROM R ORDER BY ID. a: BeginTrans; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (30, 300, 'x30'); DELETE FROM R WHERE ID = 2 (dbFailOnError). b: hd and hs MoveFirst, read all, RecordCount. a: CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. b: waits 7 s; the same reads as is; DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache); the same reads; Requery on both and the same reads.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
